scenario: NssCheck failure plus a TLS/NSS-flavored journal error referencing a legacy cert8.db, with no certificate-expiry finding anywhere in the run
notes: This looks exactly like an expired/broken certificate but is actually a local NSS DB format mismatch (legacy cert8.db/key3.db vs. cert9.db/key4.db) per 389-ds-base GitHub #2100 / Pagure #49041. No ipahealthcheck.ipa.certs/dogtag.ca finding is present, so the rule diagnoses this confidently (HIGH confidence: both the NssCheck finding and the journal TLS error corroborate) rather than treating it as a certificate-lifecycle problem, and its `why`/`limitations` text explicitly tells the administrator to also check the certificates pack's output.
